欽天監承德郎李欽增補
閩書林喬山堂劉大易繡梓
juan1_opening_imprint.note: 劉大易 is the given name of the Jianyang printer Liu Longtian 劉龍田; 喬山堂 is his shop. 閩書林 = the Fujian (Jianyang) book quarter. Red seals at lower right of the juan-1 opening leaf; National Palace Museum digital watermark 國立故宮博物院 overlays the scans.

edition_identity.seals: Juan 1 opening leaf lower right: two red collection seals (small, partially legible in scan); TOC first leaf carries red seals in the title column area including a gourd-shaped seal. To be detailed if legible on closer reading.
edition_identity.toc_contents_confirmed: 卷一 諸家起例/吉凶起例/闗煞起例; 卷二 子平舉要歌/詳解定真論/喜忌篇/繼善篇; 卷三 論正官…看命入式/造化氣/十段錦/格局生死決; 卷四 雜論口訣/群興論/論興亡/實法第一/實法第二(神趣八法: 類象屬象從象化象照象鬼象伏象)/傷官說/心鏡歌/寸金搜髓論/論細命法/相心賦/玄機賦/妖祥賦/絡繹賦/捷馳千里馬/五行消息賦/又賦/幽微賦/金玉賦/萬金賦/淵源集說/造微賦/人鑑論/愛憎賦; 卷五 內十八格/外十八格/百章歌; 卷六 批命活用總套/批富貴貧賤總套 目錄終 (PDF pages 1-2)

collation_notes: PDF page 2 left half carries the woodcut frontispiece 造化玄機 (master reading a fate-board for clients).
TOC lists 傷官說 between 神趣八法 items and 心鏡歌 in 卷四 — not in the task's known map.
